找湾区免费或低价活动，适合先看当天和本周末有什么。: Find free or inexpensive Bay Area events, starting with today or the coming weekend.
想控制周末预算、临时找去处的人。: People planning a low-cost weekend or a spontaneous outing.
按日期挑活动，再打开主办方页面核对地点、入场方式和 RSVP；把感兴趣的活动与站: Choose a date, then check the organizer for the venue, admission and RSVP. Compare your shortlist with the BAYLINK calendar.
以旧金山及湾区活动资讯为主，收录密度因地区而异。: Covers San Francisco and the Bay Area, with different listing density by area.
“免费”可能有登记、时段或消费条件；这是资讯网站，实际举办与入场规则由主办方决定: Free listings may have registration, time or purchase conditions. The organizer determines whether the event runs and how admission works.
平台定位与湾区范围。: Platform purpose and Bay Area focus.
找演出、音乐、喜剧、艺术与城市夜生活的本地资讯入口。: A local starting point for concerts, music, comedy, arts and nightlife.
想持续关注场馆、演出和本地文化的人。: People who want to follow venues, performances and local culture.
按日期和兴趣筛选，关注常去场馆的列表，再跳转售票方核对年龄限制、开门与演出时间。: Filter by date and interest, follow familiar venues, then check the ticket seller for age rules, doors and show times.
面向旧金山湾区，主要用于活动发现与精选。: Focused on discovery and curated events across the San Francisco Bay Area.
抽奖、活动推荐与付费会员是不同事项；看见 Win Tickets 不代表已取得门: Giveaways, recommendations and paid membership are separate. A Win Tickets listing is not an admission ticket.
活动类别、列表来源与抽奖功能。: Event categories, listing sources and giveaways.
发现活动、完成报名并集中保存电子票，常用于讲座、社区活动和演出。: Discover events, register and keep digital tickets together for talks, community activities and performances.
需要按日期、地点、价格筛选并管理报名的人。: People filtering by date, location and price and managing registrations.
选择实际城市与线下活动，检查主办方；报名后在 Tickets 找二维码、时间和地: Choose the actual city and in-person events, check the organizer, then find your QR code and details under Tickets after registering. Add the event to your calendar.
可搜索湾区城市；每场活动由各自主办方发布和管理。: Searchable by Bay Area city; each event is published and managed by its organizer.
收藏不等于报名，免费活动也可能需要票；付费票退款按活动政策申请，先看结账总额。: Liking is not registering, and free events may require tickets. Check the checkout total and the event refund policy.
查找活动、Tickets 与退款入口。: Event search, Tickets and refund requests.
围绕徒步、语言、技术或兴趣加入本地小组，适合建立可重复参加的社交安排。: Join local hiking, language, technology or hobby groups and build a recurring social routine.
刚搬来想认识同好，或想培养固定兴趣的人。: Newcomers seeking shared interests and residents building a regular hobby.
设定常活动的城市，先看小组最近几次活动与主办人说明，选择符合自己程度的一次并 R: Set your usual city, review recent events and organizer notes, then RSVP to an activity that fits your experience.
位置与兴趣影响推荐；湾区各城的小组活跃度不同。: Recommendations depend on location and interests; group activity varies by Bay Area city.
注册账号免费不代表每场活动免费；核对报名费、取消规则、集合点与是否仍有名额。: A free account does not make every event free. Check fees, cancellation terms, meeting points and availability.
按位置和兴趣发现小组。: Discover groups by location and interest.
用所属图书馆借书证借电子书与有声书，也能查馆藏和排队预约。: Borrow ebooks and audiobooks with your library card, search the collection and place holds.
通勤听书、读中文或英文书的居民与家庭。: Residents and families reading Chinese or English books or listening during a commute.
从官网进入应用商店，找到自己的图书馆并输入有效卡号；先筛可借书目，App 可下载: Use the official download links, select your library and add a valid card. Filter for available titles; the app can download loans for offline reading.
湾区参与的图书馆各自采购馆藏；SFPL 已提供服务，其他馆需查自己的数字资源。: Participating Bay Area libraries provide their own collections. SFPL offers it; check your own library’s digital resources.
办卡资格、借阅额度和等待名单由图书馆决定；网页离线能力与 App 不相同。: Card eligibility, limits and waiting lists depend on the library. The website does not offer the same offline use as the app.
下载、借书证、借阅与离线阅读。: Downloads, cards, loans and offline reading.
本地馆实际提供 Libby 与多语言馆藏。: Local access to Libby and multilingual collections.
通过参与图书馆借电子书、有声书和其他数字内容，可作为 Libby 以外的另一个馆: Access ebooks, audiobooks and other digital material through participating libraries, alongside Libby.
已有借书证、想多找一套数字馆藏的人。: Library cardholders seeking another digital collection.
先从自己的图书馆官网进入 hoopla，关联有效卡号，再查看可借内容与剩余额度；: Start at your library’s website, connect your valid card, then check titles and remaining borrows. Use mobile or web access.
SFPL 提供该服务；其他湾区图书馆的订阅、内容种类与额度不一定相同。: SFPL provides access; subscriptions, content types and limits vary at other Bay Area libraries.
并非所有内容都能立即借到；SFPL 也有 Flex 内容。Kindle Pape: Not every title is instantly available; SFPL also has Flex titles. Kindle Paperwhite and similar e-ink readers cannot directly use hoopla.
官方借阅入口、Flex 内容与设备限制。: Official access, Flex titles and device limitations.
查看山火事件、地图与更新，帮助了解住处和出游方向周边的火情。: View wildfire incidents, maps and updates around home and planned trips.
住山麓、常去北湾或山地活动的人。: Foothill residents and people visiting the North Bay or mountain areas.
安装后选择关心的县并检查通知权限；先查看事件更新时间，关注具体火情时再打开该事件: Select relevant counties and check notification permissions. Read the update time and follow individual incidents when needed.
提供加州等服务区域资讯；通知按所选县发送，不按离火场的半径自动筛选。: Covers California and other service areas. Notifications follow selected counties rather than a radius around a fire.
免费账号可订阅最多四个县；网页不提供 App 推送。并非每条更新都会报警，仍需订: Free accounts can subscribe to four counties. Web access does not deliver app pushes, and not every update triggers an alert. Also subscribe to official county emergency notices.
2026-09-30 更新的县级通知与免费额度。: County notifications and free limits updated September 30, 2026.
查询空气质量、预报与烟雾地图，适合安排跑步、亲子户外和山地行程前查看。: Check air quality, forecasts and smoke maps before runs, family outings or mountain trips.
需要根据当地空气情况调整户外活动的人。: People adjusting outdoor plans to local air conditions.
查看目的地当前 AQI 和数据时间，再对照预报；有烟霾时打开 Fire and: Check your destination’s current AQI and data time, compare the forecast, and use the Fire and Smoke Map during smoke events. Recheck before leaving.
美国官方空气质量资讯可查询湾区；可见数据取决于监测点与预报区域。: Official U.S. air-quality information includes the Bay Area; available data depends on monitors and forecast areas.
预报与当前监测值是不同信息，不能仅凭一张早上的截图判断下午；个人健康安排按官方建: Forecasts and current readings differ. A morning screenshot may not describe the afternoon; use official guidance and your own circumstances.
2026 年官方确认 App、网页与烟雾地图入口。: 2026 confirmation of app, web and smoke-map access.
接收基于 ShakeAlert 的地震预警，并查看地震资讯与使用设置。: Receive ShakeAlert-powered earthquake early warnings and view earthquake information and settings.
长期住在湾区、希望提前设置预警的居民。: Bay Area residents who want to configure earthquake warnings in advance.
从 UC Berkeley 官网下载，按系统说明配置通知、定位或 HomeBas: Download through UC Berkeley, configure notifications and location or HomeBase, and learn the difference between warnings and post-earthquake notifications.
预警服务适用于加州、俄勒冈州和华盛顿州，包括湾区。: Early-warning coverage includes California, Oregon and Washington, including the Bay Area.
预警表示地震已经发生，不是预测；震中附近可能来不及提前收到，实际摇晃时不能等待手: Warnings mean an earthquake has begun; they are not predictions. Near the epicenter, warnings may arrive too late, so do not wait for a phone alert when shaking begins.
读湾区新闻、听本地广播与播客，持续了解交通、住房、教育和文化议题。: Read Bay Area news and listen to local radio and podcasts on transport, housing, education and culture.
想跟进本地公共议题，或利用通勤听新闻的人。: People following local public affairs or listening to news on a commute.
在官网先选感兴趣的栏目；常听广播再装官方 App，收藏节目并按需要设置节目提醒。: Start with topics on the website. Install the official app for regular listening, save shows and configure program reminders as needed.
北加州公共媒体，重点覆盖湾区；提供 iOS、Android 与网页入口。: Northern California public media with a Bay Area focus and iOS, Android and web access.
免费 App 与 Passport 等会员权益是不同服务；新闻报道时间和事件发生: The free app and membership benefits such as Passport are separate services. Check both publication and event dates.
免费应用、系统平台、广播及新闻功能。: Free app, supported platforms, radio and news features.
查看旧金山城市新闻、商业、文化和餐饮报道，补充活动清单之外的本地背景。: Read San Francisco news, business, culture and food coverage for context beyond event listings.
住在或经常进入旧金山、想了解街区变化的人。: People living in or frequently visiting San Francisco who follow neighborhood changes.
按 News、Business 或 Culture 进入主题，检查报道日期与后续: Browse News, Business or Culture, checking publication dates and follow-ups. Mobile readers can follow the app link from the official site.
以旧金山为报道核心，不能用单篇报道代表湾区所有城市。: Reporting centers on San Francisco; one article does not represent every Bay Area city.
有付费订阅与登录入口；阅读前看清可访问范围和订阅条件，并区分新闻报道与 Opin: Paid subscriptions and sign-in are offered. Check access and subscription terms and distinguish reporting from the Opinion section.
本地报道定位、栏目及 App 与付费订阅入口。: Local reporting focus, sections, app and paid-subscription links.
